name: Shifting Combatant
description: General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+, Weapon Mastery Feature) You gain the following benefits.

features.name: Ability Score Increase
features.description: Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

features.name: Domino Strike
features.description: When you hit a creature with a weapon and activate the Push mastery property to push that creature into a space occupied by a Large or smaller creature, you can force the creatures to collide. Each creature makes a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus the ability modifier of the score increased by this feat and your Proficiency Bonus), taking 1d10 Bludgeoning damage on a failed save.

features.name: Fearless Leap
features.description: When you make a Long Jump, moving at least 10 feet immediately before the jump, and land in a space within 5 feet of two or more enemies, attack rolls made against you have Disadvantage until the start of your next turn.
